title: Feature Flags, Cohorts, Remote Configuration & Kill Switches
objective: Provide governed cohort targeting, staged rollout, feature flags, remote safe configuration and kill switches for risky/experimental capabilities, including AI/community surfaces when applicable, without changing canonical game-state authority.
acceptance: A feature can be enabled for a bounded cohort, disabled after a simulated defect and later re-enabled without corrupting Campaign state or silently changing user consent/permissions.
boundaries: BRP-01..06 and SMB-01..16 remain sealed predecessor authority.
BRP-07 is selected_not_started only and has no implementation authority until governed start.
Feature/config rollout controls may gate capability availability but may not create canonical gameplay, Campaign, identity, consent, permission or family-policy truth.
AI/community surfaces remain subject to their existing authority and consent/family-safety boundaries; a flag cannot override them.
Tester distribution, public beta/community activation, release, paid providers, commerce and BRP-08+ remain unauthorized.
BRP must complete through BRP-11 BETA_READY before normal SMB-17 activation.
next_action: Await owner Continue to govern-start BRP-07 — Feature Flags, Cohorts, Remote Configuration & Kill Switches. Do not begin implementation before authority is granted.

stop_reason.evidence: BRP-06 completed_verified and strict BRP order selects BRP-07.
